description.value:
Effect Hit bonus +2. Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save; failure marks the target for allied direct-hit damage taken +1 for 2 turns, increasing to +2 while it carries a tracked DoT sourced to you. No DoT damage bonus.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.
